## Background

Hardware/software bring-up of OARbot as a data-collection instrument:
drivers and control interface, teleoperation input device, camera and
joint-state streams, latency and calibration checks. Closes when a
demonstrator can perform a task on the real robot and every relevant
signal is recorded in sync — the precondition for
[B2](../B2-demonstration-dataset/README.qmd).

## Status log

- **2026-08-27:** First lab session — day-1 checklist completed.
  Laptop ↔ robot communication established (WSL firewall was the
  blocker), full topic inventory saved, rates measured, teleop command
  interface identified and captured live, and external command
  authority proven (laptop moved the arm). Camera bandwidth
  measurement confirms recording must happen on the helper laptop.
  → [Lab notebook, day-1 entry](../../../../chapters/03-operation/lab-notebook.qmd)
- **2026-08-26:** Platform documentation digested ahead of first lab
  session — ROS 2 comms architecture (CycloneDDS, domain bridge),
  kinova-ros2 interface incl. the exact-100 Hz command requirement, and
  the day-1 reconnaissance checklist.
  → [Platform notes](../../../../chapters/03-operation/platform-notes.qmd)
